checks.explanation: Global AI data center investment reached into the low trillions of dollars cumulatively across 2025-2030 pledges (Stargate alone committing several hundred billion), consistent with the 1-2 trillion dollar prediction.

Democratic socialist candidates won prominent races (notably Zohran Mamdani's November 2025 NYC mayoral win), but socialism has not 'swept' the nation as a whole; national politics remained a contested and largely non-socialist landscape overall.

No Generation IV nuclear reactor had begun construction or production in the US within roughly 18 months of this August 2025 discussion (i.e., by early 2027); advanced reactor projects, including at Idaho National Laboratory, remained in earlier development stages.

Zohran Mamdani won the November 2025 NYC mayoral election with over 50% of the vote against Cuomo and Sliwa, confirming the electoral premise; whether his policies will prove to be 'epic failures' remains to be seen since his term only began January 2026.
Mamdani's term as NYC mayor only began in January 2026, so the predicted 1-2 year timeframe for his policies to severely damage the city has not yet elapsed.

The Fed did cut rates by roughly 75 basis points across September-December 2025, but inflation did not rise back to a 3-handle; CPI remained roughly in the high-2% to low-3% range through this period without a clear inflation resurgence.

2025 US tariff revenue came in substantial but below the very highest projections given the mid-year tariff start, while 2026 revenue trended toward the predicted $200-500 billion range as tariffs applied for a full year, roughly matching the prediction's shape.

The Fed did cut rates through late 2025 partly in response to labor market weakness, but this was not clearly driven by falling tariff revenue and falling demand/inflation as specifically described; the causal chain predicted was more mixed in practice.

Smuggling and circumvention of US chip export controls into China continued through 2025-2026 despite enforcement efforts, remaining a persistent but not war-deciding factor in the overall US-China AI compute competition.

Apple continued developing AR/smart glasses products through 2025-2026 without yet having released a market-leading consumer AR glasses product as of mid-2026, so this 3-4 year prediction (to 2028-2029) remains too early to call.
US EV adoption continued growing through 2025-2026 but cumulative EV totals had not yet reached the roughly 30 million mark by mid-2026, and 2030 remains too far out to fully evaluate.
No independently verifiable data on All-In Summit scholarship response times was found to confirm or refute this operational claim.
